primary_link.title: TactiPlay: Multi-Granularity Tactical Parsing and Video-Anchored Match Review for Amateur Badminton Players

radar.summary: Amateur badminton players increasingly record matches, yet existing tools provide only aggregate statistics or generic summaries, leaving most unable to extract tactical insights without expert guidance. A formative study (N=8) reveals the need for multi-granularity, video-anchored tactical analysis centered on rallies. We derive a taxonomy of performance issues from national-level athletes' annotations and present TactiPlay, an interactive system that instantiates an expert-taxonomy-guided, ral
radar.summary_zh: TactiPlay 是一個專為業餘羽球選手設計的互動式賽後回顧系統，旨在解決他們缺乏專業教練與結構化分析方法、難以從比賽錄影中提取戰術洞見的問題。研究團隊先透過前導性研究（N=8）釐清業餘選手的需求，並邀請國家級選手對七場業餘比賽影片進行逐球註解，歸納出包含技術執行、站位與回位、戰術選擇三大面向、共17個子項的表現問題分類法。系統的運算管線先以電腦視覺與視覺語言模型（VLM）偵測比賽事件，包括球賽回合分割、球員定位、羽球軌跡與擊球分類，再以GPT-4.1將這些事件對應到專家分類法，產生結構化的回饋報告，涵蓋輸球模式、贏球模式、非終局的戰術意識問題與技術執行問題等四大主題。介面設計上，TactiPlay 提供色彩編碼的回合時間軸、自動生成的回合解說、動態球場熱區圖，以及與影片片段直接連結的子主題卡片，讓選手能從回合層級切入，逐步深入至戰術序列與單一擊球。研究者進行一項受試者內設計實驗（N=16），比較 TactiPlay 與一個類似商業產品的報告與統計基線系統。結果顯示，使用 TactiPlay 時，參與者產生的反思更頻繁、更具體、更可行且更適切，也更廣泛地涵蓋站位與戰術選擇層面；多數參與者（16人中的12人）採用由報告導向影片證據的驗證策略。不過，研究仍有若干限制：參與者僅限於20至27歲的初級至中級單打選手；評估聚焦於反思品質而非實際比賽表現的改變；系統依賴人工驗證的擊球與回合標註，且尚未驗證每個自動生成的戰術診斷的正確性。整體而言，TactiPlay 展示如何將比賽證據組織成具專家分類法引導、以回合為單位的影片錨定工作流程，以提升業餘選手的戰術反思能力，為未來運動分析系統的設計提供了重要參考。
radar.title: TactiPlay: Multi-Granularity Tactical Parsing and Video-Anchored Match Review for Amateur Badminton Players
radar.title_zh: TactiPlay：面向業餘羽球選手的多粒度戰術解析與影片錨定比賽回顧系統

links.title: Genie Sim PanoWorld: An Infinite Indoor 3D World Generation Pipeline via Panoramic Scene Modeling and Simulation

evidence: Paper title and abstract describe a single-panorama-to-3D pipeline with feed-forward reconstruction and video diffusion.
The paper is explicitly about indoor 3D world generation, navigation, and simulation, without any language or LLM component.
Experimental sections (Section 4) provide quantitative comparisons with baselines (Matrix-3D, OmniRoam) and ablation studies (Tables 2-9) on metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, ATE, and rendering quality.
llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper is a computer vision / 3D scene generation paper with a video diffusion component but no LLM or language methodology. It falls under the out-of-scope category for preference relevance, which is capped at 0.20. Despite outstanding technical contributions in 3D scene synthesis from panoramas, it does not engage with LLMs, language, or the specified areas, so preference relevance is low. However, the technical novelty (feed-forward single-panorama-to-3D pipeline with trajectory control, shortcut model and mixed training) is substantial, and the paper provides rigorous quantitative experiments with ablations, baselines, and detailed results, earning high marks on novelty, rigor, evidence strength, and reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Genie Sim PanoWorld: An Infinite Indoor 3D World Generation Pipeline via Panoramic Scene Modeling and Simulation

radar.summary: We address the problem of reconstructing a high-fidelity, freely navigable 3D scene from a single $360^\circ$ panorama, without per-scene optimization or multi-view capture. Existing methods either lack metric trajectory control, which hinders reliable downstream 3D reconstruction, or struggle with large disocclusions under long-range camera motion while requiring high-end multi-GPU servers.We present Genie Sim PanoWorld, a two-stage feed-forward pipeline that bridges generation and reconstructi
radar.summary_zh: 本論文提出名為 Genie Sim PanoWorld 的兩階段前饋式管線，旨在從單張 360° 等距柱狀投影（ERP）全景圖，生成可自由漫遊的高保真 3D 高斯場景，且無需針對每個場景進行最佳化或使用多視角拍攝。其核心方法是將生成與重建任務，透過一條具明確軌跡控制的全景影片串接起來。首先，從輸入全景估測深度並建立粗略場景網格，再利用導航網格（NavMesh）規劃一條無碰撞的 SE(3) 漫遊軌跡。接著，此軌跡以稠密幾何變形條件注入潛在影片擴散模型（基於 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 並運用 LoRA），模型經由長短軌跡混合訓練與基於捷徑模型（shortcut models）的自洽性目標訓練，實現僅需四個去噪步驟且不需分類器自由引導（CFG）的高品質影片生成。隨後，一個前饋式全景重建器（延伸自 VGGT）從生成的影片中估測相機姿態與稠密幾何，並以體素對齊的高斯解碼器將觀測融合為可即時渲染的 3D 高斯場景。實驗結果顯示，在室內全景影片生成與下游 3D 重建上，此方法在多項指標上優於幾何條件基線（如 Matrix-3D），並能零樣本泛化至未見場景，同時在單一消費級 GPU 上完成整個流程，無需逐場景最佳化。主要限制包括假設場景靜態、依賴單目深度品質，以及現行訓練資料以室內環境為主。此工作對於虛擬導覽、互動式內容創作與具身智慧模擬等應用具有重要意義，提供了一條從單張全景圖到可探索 3D 世界的實用路徑。
radar.title: Genie Sim PanoWorld: An Infinite Indoor 3D World Generation Pipeline via Panoramic Scene Modeling and Simulation
radar.title_zh: Genie Sim PanoWorld：透過全景場景建模與模擬的無限室內 3D 世界生成管線

links.title: Learning from the Future: Privileged Self-Distillation for Sequential Recommendation

evidence: Section 4.2 (Overall Performance): Tables 3 shows consistent gains over baselines across datasets and backbones.
Section 4.3 (Impact of Future Visibility): Figure 3 shows teacher and student improvements with future visibility.
Section 4.4 (Oracle Analysis): Figure 4 indicates privileged knowledge is transferred to causal student.
Section 4.5.2 (Parameter Sensitivity): Figure 6 shows robustness to hyperparameters.
llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper is on sequential recommendation, an application-specific domain; it does not involve LLMs, Japanese NLP, or language-centric methodology. Core techniques (privileged self-distillation, momentum teacher, gating) are established in knowledge distillation and semi-supervised learning. Empirical validation across three datasets and three backbones with multiple baselines and ablations is rigorous, but reproducibility is limited by incomplete hyperparameter details and code availability. Novelty is moderate: applies privileged information to sequential recommendation with a dual-mask single-backbone approach. Generalizability to other domains is plausible but not demonstrated.

primary_link.title: Learning from the Future: Privileged Self-Distillation for Sequential Recommendation

radar.summary: Sequential recommenders are commonly trained with one-hot next-item labels under a causal (prefix-only) objective aligned with inference. While deployment-compatible, this supervision offers little insight into relative preferences among non-target items. Yet logged interaction sequences contain an additional supervisory source: interactions following the target often reveal how user intent evolves, making the target easier to interpret. We treat these future interactions as training-only privil
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出「特權自蒸餾」（Privileged Self-Distillation, PSD），一種為序列推薦模型設計的訓練框架，讓模型在部署時保持因果性的同時，充分利用訓練數據中的未來交互資訊。序列推薦器在線上推論時，只能根據使用者過去的行為序列預測下一個互動項目，因此傳統訓練方式以因果式的下一項預測為目標，採用獨熱標籤進行監督。然而，這種監督方式資訊量低，未能充分利用記錄中目標項目之後的互動序列。作者將這些未來交互視為「訓練專用的特權資訊」：在訓練時可取得，但在推論時不可用。PSD 的核心機制是對同一個 Transformer 骨幹施加兩種注意力遮罩：一種是特權遮罩，讓教師模型同時看到過去與未來；另一種是因果遮罩，讓學生模型僅看到過去，與部署時的資訊路徑一致。教師模型透過標準的交叉熵損失以觀測到的目標項目進行監督，而學生模型則透過 KL 散度蒸餾教師模型的軟性機率分佈來學習，而非直接擬合獨熱標籤。此框架無需額外參數、輔助特徵或多階段訓練，教師與學生共享參數，因此教師的優勢來自資訊存取而非模型容量。為了解決教師訊號中部分無法從因果前綴推得（即不可達）的問題，PSD 引入「優勢可達性閘門」，根據批次內 KL 散度的百分位數過濾掉高差異的蒸餾項；同時，為了穩定自參照的監督訊號，採用指數移動平均（EMA）的教師參數。實驗在三個公開基準資料集（Amazon Video Games、CDs & Vinyl 與 Yelp）上進行，並涵蓋 SASRec、BERT4Rec 與 UniSRec 三種骨幹，結果顯示 PSD 在所有設定下均持續且顯著地優於強基線，平均提升約 19.8%，且無任何回歸案例。診斷分析進一步證實，未來可見性確實提升了教師的預測品質，而學生能繼承其中可達的部分；優勢可達性閘門能有效過濾不可達的訊號，EMA 教師則能穩定訓練動態。此方法的限制在於其依賴 Transformer 架構，且超參數（如閘門百分位與 EMA 率）需調整，但整體而言，PSD 提供了一種簡單且有效的方式，讓序列推薦模型能「向未來學習」而不違反部署時的因果約束，為序列預測任務提供了新的訓練策略。
radar.title: Learning from the Future: Privileged Self-Distillation for Sequential Recommendation
radar.title_zh: 向未來學習：序列推薦中的特權自蒸餾

links.title: Property-driven Causal Abstractions for Markov Decision Processes

evidence: Section I Introduction: introduces property-driven causal abstractions for MDPs
Section II Related Work: discusses novelty over existing abstraction methods
Section VI Experimental Evaluation: provides quantitative results
Appendix D Artifact: code publicly available
llm_evaluation.rationale: Paper focuses on causal abstractions for Markov Decision Processes, a topic in formal verification and planning, not directly aligned with the listed preferences (LLM, NLP, etc.). It does not involve language models or natural language processing; it is a domain-specific application in AI. Thus low preference relevance. However, the paper is rigorous with formal proofs, extensive experiments, and provides a public implementation, offering strong novelty in integrating causality with MDP abstraction. High rigor and evidence strength, good generalizability to scaling MDP models, but limited to the MDP domain.

primary_link.title: Property-driven Causal Abstractions for Markov Decision Processes

radar.summary: Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are widely used as decision-making models, commonly specified over factored state spaces through state variables and their valuations. The exponential blowup in the number of states renders many reasoning tasks in MDPs challenging. Abstractions are promising techniques to reduce MDPs and thus mitigate scalability issues. In this work, we introduce a notion of causality on factored MDPs and a novel property-driven causal abstraction technique that retains many cha
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一種針對因子化馬可夫決策過程（factored MDP）的性質驅動因果抽象化技術，旨在緩解狀態空間爆炸問題。作者借鑑特徵因果性（feature causality）的概念，定義了基於狀態變數謂詞的因果關係，並據此將狀態空間劃分為不同區域。具體方法包括一次性劃分（one-shot partition）、迭代劃分（iterative partition）與因果圖劃分（causal graph partition），再結合三種聚合方式：加權平均（WA）得到抽象MDP、區間MDP（IMDP）以及隨機賽局（SG）。理論上，IMDP與SG抽象能提供包含原MDP值的有界保證，而加權平均則無保證。實驗使用多個標準基準測試，結果顯示因果抽象能大幅縮減模型規模，同時在許多情況下保持良好的策略品質；其中SG聚合表現最佳，迭代劃分在品質上優於其他劃分。此外，從小型模型學到的因果關係可推廣至大型模型，但策略效能有時會下降。作者指出目前方法需要精確分析完整MDP以取得因果資訊，是主要的限制，未來可透過資料或學習模型來近似，以提升可擴展性。此研究為將因果推理應用於MDP提供了形式化基礎，並展示了其在模型抽象上的潛力。
radar.title: Property-driven Causal Abstractions for Markov Decision Processes
radar.title_zh: 馬可夫決策過程的性質驅動因果抽象化

links.title: BayesAME: Bayesian Active Model Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: 'Evaluating large generative models across benchmarks is time-consuming'
Section 1: 'a growing number of methods estimate full benchmark performance by evaluating models on only a subset of items'
Figure 1 and Table 1: extensive experiments across benchmarks
Algorithm 1: detailed algorithm for automatic coreset size
llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper focuses on efficient evaluation of large generative models via coreset selection with Bayesian active model evaluation. It directly targets benchmark evaluation of LLMs, aligning with preference for LLM evaluation. It contributes a novel Bayesian framework for automatic coreset size determination, with rigorous empirical validation across multiple benchmarks and regimes. However, the paper is not primarily about Japanese LLMs or other highly weighted topics; its topic relevance is moderate. Its novelty and rigor are strong within its niche, and reproducibility is supported by detailed experimental details.

primary_link.title: BayesAME: Bayesian Active Model Evaluation

radar.summary: Evaluating large generative models across benchmarks is time-consuming and computationally expensive. This drives the need for methods that can estimate full benchmark performance by evaluating models on only a subset of items, known as a coreset. Current literature mostly requires the practitioner to input a coreset size. However, when reliable performance estimation takes priority over efficiency, an evaluation method should also be capable of automatically determining a coreset size that refl
radar.summary_zh: 評估大型生成模型在基準測試上的表現通常耗時且計算成本高昂，因此需要僅評估部分項目（稱之為 coreset）來估計完整基準成績。現有方法多要求使用者預先指定 coreset 大小，然而當可靠估計重於效率時，應能自動決定所需規模。本文提出 BayesAME，一個循序貝氏框架，能自動決定 coreset 大小。BayesAME 將表現視為隨機變數，對共享相同歷史模型表現的項目群組定義潛在能力，並以聯合高斯先驗編碼目標模型與歷史模型行為相似的信念。後驗分布用於推導表現估計器、量化不確定性，並透過資訊增益準則選擇加入 coreset 的項目。coreset 逐步擴增，直到表現估計波動與不確定性低於使用者定義的閾值。此外，作者提出多目標擴展，主動捕捉多個目標模型間的相關性以進一步縮減 coreset。實驗涵蓋多種基準與內插/外插情境，結果顯示 BayesAME 持續優於現有方法的循序改編版。重要地，本研究反駁近期文獻的懷疑，證明非隨機 coreset 選擇確實優於隨機選擇，且能可靠地超越隨機樣本平均基線。同時，利用連續回應對數似然而非二元分數能顯著提升估計準確度。局限性包括假設分數為純量，未來可擴展至多維或非結構化評估格式。此研究對高效模型評估領域具有重要性，提供自動停止準則與穩健估計，並釐清主動選擇的價值。
radar.title: BayesAME: Bayesian Active Model Evaluation
radar.title_zh: BayesAME：貝氏主動模型評估

primary_link.title: A Compositional Theory of Causally Masked Transformers

top5.summary: What types of decision problems can a causally masked, finite-precision transformer solve for inputs of arbitrary length? Existing answers often rely on idealized arithmetic, but under finite precision, rounding and evaluation order can change what information attention retains and therefore what the model can compute. We develop an algebraic formalization that derives expressivity directly from the model's implemented dynamics. Its central object is its memory; the finite internal state compute
top5.summary_zh: 本文提出一個代數框架，用以分析因果遮罩、有限精度 Transformer 在任意長度輸入下所能解決的決策問題。與既有研究常依賴理想化算術不同，作者強調在有限精度浮點數運算下，捨入與評估順序會改變注意力保留的資訊，進而影響模型的可計算能力。他們將 Transformer 的形式化建立在其實際運算動態上，核心概念是「記憶」：由注意力計算出的有限內部狀態，此狀態對所有未來查詢而言，是前綴資訊的充分統計量。每個注意力頭各自更新其狀態，而層與層之間則以階層方式組合，提供了一條從模型假設到表達力界限的統一途徑。應用此方法於無位置編碼（NoPE）的 Transformer，作者依注意力類型與數值語義，得到了表達力階層：寬度為一的滑動視窗注意力支援有界後綴記憶；修正後的銳利 Soft Attention 支援不可逆的檢查清單式狀態；兩者結合則可同時具備兩種特性；而一般的由左至右浮點 Soft Attention 則能實現比上述任何一種都更具表達力的記憶操作。代數上，這四種情況分別對應到 definite、R-trivial、locally R-trivial 與 aperiodic 半群。在明確的自由佈線假設下，這四個界限都是緊的。此框架的價值在於它直接從架構內部動態推導表達力，而非依賴外部形式體系，並揭示了數值語義（如評估順序）對表達力的關鍵影響。此研究受限於無位置編碼的設定，且其分析基於有限精度與固定參數，未來可延伸至其他位置編碼或數值格式。

top5.summary: Post-training alignment is often shallow, eroding under fine-tuning. Whether midtraining interventions, cleanly isolated from post-training, can produce durable alignment remains untested. We test this via constitutional midtraining: inserting principled, values-based content into midtraining against a replay-only control at 120B scale. Our 394M-token constitutional corpus, built from Anthropic's Constitution, uses a 2x2 factorial design (curriculum ordering x deliberative reasoning) to produce
top5.summary_zh: 本研究探討中期訓練階段引入憲法式內容是否能產生持久且可泛化的對齊效益。作者以Anthropic憲法為基礎，建立涵蓋38個憲法價值、總計約2.58億token的合成語料庫，並以Nemotron-3-Super-120B模型進行中期訓練，實驗設計採2×2因子（課程排序與審議式推理），比較四種憲法式中期訓練條件與對照組，後續統一進行價值中立的監督式微調與良性微調，以隔離中期訓練的獨立效果。評估涵蓋分布內外行為、對齊偽裝、勒索、湧現性失準、壓力下對齊、價值衝突解決及一般能力基準。結果顯示，憲法式中期訓練在分布內、分布外及勒索基準上穩定優於對照組，尤其能緩和監督式微調所誘發的勒索傾向，且此優勢在良性微調後仍持續；但在需要主動抵抗情境壓力或衝突的任務上，優勢在監督式微調後消失。內容存在比結構（課程排序或推理）更重要，且未造成能力退化。限制包括架構與憲法來源的單一性、訓練規模有限、未納入DPO，以及無法排除評估察覺等。此研究提供低成本、可補充現行以監督式微調為主的對齊流程，並顯示中期訓練內容對持久對齊的重要性。

primary_link.title: SecRespond: Benchmarking AI Agents for Real-World Post-Compromise Incident Response

top5.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly adopted in real-world security operations with access to host artifacts and command-line interfaces (CLIs), making it critical to thoroughly assess their security capabilities. However, existing cybersecurity benchmarks focus on pre-compromise settings where agents are placed in a clean and idealized environment before an attack occurs. This leaves the post-compromise setting underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce SecRespond, the first
top5.summary_zh: 本文介紹SECRESPOND，這是首個專為評估大型語言模型（LLM）代理在入侵後事件回應工作流程中能力的評測基準。不同於先前多聚焦於入侵前情境（如CTF挑戰或漏洞修補）的網路安全基準，SECRESPOND模擬真實的入侵後場景：代理需分析遭入侵主機的鑑識磁碟快照，搭配主機安全產品提供的警示、漏洞掃描與基線檢查結果，產出入侵報告、漏洞報告、基線報告與修補計畫。該基準涵蓋10個網路靶場，橫跨4種入侵入口類型、21種ATT&CK技術與5種作業系統，共定義52個能力項目與280個檢查點，並採用分層級LLM-as-a-Judge評估框架，分別評分偵測與規劃兩軸。作者在OpenCode代理框架上評估23個前沿LLM，結果顯示現有代理雖能可靠地發現警示所暴露的問題，但在主動調查磁碟中的隱匿入侵、以及產出全面且經驗證的修補計畫方面表現不佳，沒有任何模型能在單一靶場上達成完全偵測與修補。研究也發現，模型在不同能力面向（如入侵實體、持久化機制、基線風險、漏洞風險、調查與回應品質）表現不均衡，且相較於傳統無代理掃描，代理模型在偵測持久化機制等面向有顯著優勢，但仍存在根本性瓶頸。本文亦探討注入程序性先驗技能對代理表現的提升效果，以及LLM法官之間的一致性與其與人類專家的對齊。此基準為開發能主動、徹底調查與回應資安事件的代理模型提供了重要評估基礎。

top5.summary: Diverse human groups produce diverse ideas, the raw material of innovation. Generative AI challenges this engine twice over: everyday AI assistance may homogenize what diverse people create, and AI-simulated diversity may replace the people altogether. We tested both challenges in a preregistered creative metaphor experiment with native (L1) and non-native (L2) English writers, who wrote without AI, with AI-generated ideas (AI ideation), or with AI refining their own ideas (AI refinement). L2 wr
top5.summary_zh: 這項研究探討生成式AI對人類創造力中「多樣性引擎」的雙重威脅：日常AI輔助可能使不同人類的創作趨於同質，而AI模擬的多樣性可能取代真實人類。研究以創意隱喻寫作為任務，招募母語英語（L1）與非母語英語（L2）寫作者，分別在無AI輔助、AI提供點子（AI ideation）、AI僅潤飾自身想法（AI refinement）三種條件下創作，並預先註冊實驗設計。結果發現，L2寫作者貢獻的集體多樣性高於L1，且當L2以母語與AI互動時多樣性最高。AI ideation壓縮了所有人的集體多樣性，並使L2的優勢消失；AI refinement則保留多樣性與L2優勢。研究者進一步利用參與者真實背景建立persona，以三種模型家族、提高取樣溫度及母語提示等方式模擬整個寫作者群體，但所有模擬池的多樣性均低於任何人類池，且僅能透過產生退化文本來增加多樣性。然而，在個人層次上，AI ideation提升了寫作者的創造力評分，形成個人利益與集體利益的衝突，尤其對L2寫作者而言，唯有以母語進行AI refinement才能兼顧兩者。研究限制包括僅測試單一創意任務、以語言背景代表多樣性、且模擬結果僅反映當前模型的能力。此研究凸顯人類多樣性仍是不可取代的創造力資源，並強調人機協作流程的設計是決定其能否存續的關鍵。

primary_link.title: Think Short, Defer Smart, Act, and Repeat: Calibrated Reasoning and Uncertainty-Aware Deferral for Edge LLM Agents

top5.summary: LLM agents following the ReAct paradigm are promising enablers of complex multi-step tasks, including multi-hop question answering, code generation, and control of physical AI systems. Yet, when deployed at the edge, they must tightly manage their reasoning budget while remaining reliable and deferring to a cloud-side model only when local uncertainty is too high to act safely. We propose Think Short, Defer Smart (TSDS), a framework that synergistically integrates a lightweight convergence probe
top5.summary_zh: 本文提出 Think Short, Defer Smart (TSDS) 框架，旨在解決邊緣部署的 LLM 代理（遵循 ReAct 範式）在推理預算、可靠性與雲端卸載之間的最佳平衡問題。TSDS 整合兩項機制：一是輕量級收斂探針，監測模型隱藏表徵，一旦預期行動趨於穩定即提早停止思考，避免過度推理；二是基於困惑度（PPL）的延遲規則，當邊緣代理對行動的不確定性過高時，將決策轉交雲端較大模型。兩者的門檻透過多目標 Learn-Then-Test (LTT) 程序聯合校準，提供關於期望 episode 獎勵與雲端呼叫率的有限樣本保證。作者在四個基準上驗證：GSM8K（算術）、HotpotQA（多跳問答）、MBPP（程式碼生成）與模擬居家機器人任務。相較僅有延遲的基線，TSDS 在後三個多步任務中減少 43% 至 73% 的每 episode 思考計算量，同時維持認證獎勵與雲端呼叫率。關鍵洞見在於思考校準與延遲具協同效應：過度思考可能讓模型對次佳行動過度自信，抑制延遲機制；而提早截斷能保留更有意義的不確定性訊號，使延遲更精準地指向困難步驟。限制包括依賴特定邊緣模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B）、PPL 作為不確定性指標的侷限，以及 LTT 對校準資料獨立同分佈的假設。此研究對資源受限環境下的可靠 AGI 部署至關重要，展示了如何透過統計校準在推理成本與任務表現間取得可證明的權衡。
